interface.shortDescription: Papers you can read, verify and play with.
interface.longDescription: Name a paper or hand over a PDF. Trace resolves it on arXiv, reads it page by page, and grounds every claim in an exact quote. The result is a portable .trace.json and a local interactive site: prerequisite primers, step-by-step derivations, live playgrounds that run the paper's own equations, a mechanism simulation, sortable result tables, an evidence-linked quiz and an application guide. Afterwards you can rewrite one section with the evidence locked, keep a story's structure as a reusable template, and publish a shareable link with publication controls. Uses the active Codex model — no separate LLM API key.
defaultPrompt: Explain Attention Is All You Need using the Trace plugin.
